status: FROZEN (Phase-0 lock-in; amendments require ADR entry in BENCHMARK_REGISTRY.md)
scope: Single authoritative benchmark definition for K=3 few-shot conformational population prediction (Abl1, Src). All papers/reports must reference this file + DEPRECATED_FILES.md.

abl1.source: Xie et al., Science 2020 (eabc2754), NMR populations
abl1.ext_notes: H396P = silver tier, M290L_H396P = silver_pH65; no experimental ddG for these two -> variant C excluded from n=8

src.source: Cui et al., Science 2025 (adw8310), Fig S5 Met305 probe
src.ext_notes: perturbations: pY419 (low tier), pY530 (medium, E2 ref), YEEI (medium, E2 ref); type flag 0/1/2
src.label_note: Met305-probe populations are probe-specific; L410A alternative global value [0.96,0.03,0.01] tracked as alternative-label sensitivity

metrics.primary: per-state MAE over K=3 states, LOO-CV, mean over folds (per-state mean abs error, mean across mutants)
metrics.direction: fraction of mutants with sign(pred_active - wt_active) == sign(target_active - wt_active) over mutants with |target_active - wt_active| >= 0.05; mutants with |target_active - wt_active| < 0.05 are ties and excluded; reported as k/total (ADR-002 2026-08-08; supersedes 'sum-abs-shift sense' text)

contrast_basis.u1: shared coarse contrast (e.g., Active vs inactive aggregate)
contrast_basis.u2: fine state contrast (I1 vs I2 / E1 vs E2)

fold_protocol.baselines_protocol: same LOO folds; CLR-ridge / CLR-GP / 1-NN on same features

feature_transforms.rule: fold-local standardization only; fits computed on training folds only; no global transforms after Phase-0 freeze
feature_transforms.note: P0-1 audit (p0_fold_local_results.json): transductive bias negligible (variant C 0.0813 vs 0.0804)

abl1_k3_n6.note: CLR/kNN best on variant C (target-coupled, not experiment-free); experiment-free baselines: CLR-GP LLR 0.2229, CLR-ridge LLR 0.2616

src_k3_n8.note: CLR-GP on Extended also 0.2560; all 0.25x on Src do not exceed training mean on u2 (F405A ~0.56)

abl1_k3_n6.note: fold_local_ESM2_PCA updated 2026-08-08: 8/4 value 0.1459 not reproducible in current venv (transformers 5.14.1/numpy 2.4.4/sklearn 1.9.0); 2026-08-09 R4 per-seed rerun (t7_fold_local_esm_pca_v2.json, n_seeds=5, GPU ESM-2) = 0.147749, v2b identical (diff 0.000000, match=True), canonical PASS; v1 superseded

src_k3_n8.note: fold_local_ESM2_PCA updated 2026-08-08: 8/4 value 0.3026 not reproducible in current venv; 2026-08-09 R4 per-seed rerun (t7_fold_local_esm_pca_v2.json, n_seeds=5, GPU ESM-2) = 0.300582, v2b identical (diff 0.000000, match=True), canonical PASS; v1 superseded

result_tiers.exploratory: single fixed config on the current panel; discovery only; no claims
result_tiers.nested_confirmatory: selection-aware outer/inner nested CV; required for any benchmark-SOTA claim (Level 2)
result_tiers.prospective: frozen model + custodian-run LOO on independent blinded panel; required for generalization claim (Level 3)

prospective_protocol.status: FIXED 2026-08-06 (was contradictory: within-system LOO vs pre-reveal blind)
prospective_protocol.primary_A: zero-shot state-specific FoldX (no new-system mutant labels; pre-reveal predictions hashed)
prospective_protocol.primary_B: custodian-run frozen few-shot LOO (model code/container frozen; custodian holds labels; outputs delivered only at unblinding)
prospective_protocol.rule: both endpoints frozen before any new-panel label is seen

result_schema.rule: save per-fold and per-seed predictions; never only aggregates
